import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Pairwise scatter plot for petal measurements (top-left)
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 0].scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')
axes[0, 0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Pairwise scatter plot for sepal measurements (top-right)
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    axes[0, 1].scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                       label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')
axes[0, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Box plot for all measurements (bottom-left)
data_to_plot = df.melt(id_vars='species', 
                       value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                       var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=data_to_plot, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'])
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Violin plot comparing petal length distribution (bottom-right)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', ax=axes[1, 1], inner='box')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
